Standard Errors and Intervals of a Fit for a Chosen Information

Source: R/fit_distrib.R
fit_report.Rd

Returns the quantities of fit_inference() for the information selected by an Information object, or by the default of the family when information is NULL. The fit stores the quantities of the default information (default_information()), and they are returned when the selected information is the default; otherwise the link-scale variance matrix is recomputed by vcov.distrib_fit() and carried through fit_inference().

Usage

fit_report(object, information = NULL)

Arguments

object

A distrib_fit() object.

information

NULL, an observed_info() or an expected_info() object.

Value

A list as returned by fit_inference().

See also

vcov.distrib_fit(), print.distrib_fit(), confint.distrib_fit(), mv_summary()
